about.text: Windows Reborn, made by Dreex. Runs locally, no telemetry. The tweaks are inspired by open-source projects such as Optimizer (hellzerg) and Microsoft's official documentation.
about.title: About
adapter.browser.warning: Bookmarks only. Restore them with the browser closed; passwords, history and sessions are not included.
adapter.git.warning: .gitconfig may reference credential helpers: review it before sharing the backup.
appx.hint: Microsoft apps that come with Windows. They're removed for your user only and can be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store.

backup.subtitle: Tick what you want to keep. A folder is created at the destination with one zip for your app settings and a separate one for your personal folders. When you import them, everything goes back to its place.

home.after.1.text: Everything goes back to its original place.
home.after.2.text: Tick the ones you want and they install themselves, always the latest version.
home.after.3.text: Telemetry, ads and AI off with one click.
home.before.1.text: Brave, .minecraft, pictures… in tidy zips on the desktop.
home.before.2.text: Tweaks, programs and choices in a single .zip.
home.before.3.text: Get Rufus and the official Windows ISO.
home.subtitle: Save your stuff, make the USB, reinstall and, once back, restore your files, install your programs and apply your privacy settings in a few clicks.
home.title: Reinstall Windows and get everything back in minutes
home.usb.steps: In Rufus: pick the USB, click "Select" to open the ISO and then "Start". Rufus can remove the Microsoft account and TPM requirements.
home.usb.text: Download the official Windows ISO from Microsoft and write it to a USB stick (8 GB or more) with Rufus.
home.usb.title: Create the installation USB
optimize.preset.text: {0} handy, safe tweaks: classic context menu, visible extensions, "End task", Game Mode and more.
optimize.preset.title: Recommended tweaks
optimize.subtitle: File Explorer, taskbar, performance and system tweaks. Each one has a risk label and can be undone.
optimize.title: Optimize
privacy.preset.text: {0} settings inspired by Optimizer and O&O ShutUp10++: telemetry, advertising ID, Copilot, Recall, Bing in search, suggestions and sponsored apps.
privacy.preset.title: Recommended privacy
privacy.subtitle: The most important part: strip Windows of telemetry, ads and snooping AI in one go, without visiting window after window. Defender, the firewall and updates are never turned off.
privacy.title: Privacy
